qis_666.desc: Hold exactly 666 qi per second for one full second.

realm_1.desc: Take your first step on the path of cultivation.

realm_10.desc: Forge your body through all ten layers of Tempered Body.
realm_10.title: Foundation Established

realm_13.desc: Master Qi Transformation. The qi within you is no longer mortal.
realm_13.title: Qi Transformed

realm_14.desc: Enter the True Element realm and command the forces of nature.
realm_14.title: True Elements Awakened

realm_18.desc: Reach Separation & Reunion. Your spirit splits to walk two paths at once.
realm_18.title: Spirit Severed

realm_21.desc: Begin your ascent beyond mortal limits.
realm_21.title: Immortal Ascension

realm_24.desc: Walk alongside those who have transcended ordinary existence.
realm_24.title: Saint's Path

realm_27.desc: Rise to the pinnacle of the Saint ranks.
realm_27.title: Saint King

realm_30.desc: Return to the source from which all qi flows.
realm_30.title: Origin Returned

realm_36.desc: Step into the void between worlds and rule it.
realm_36.title: Void King

realm_39.desc: Touch the Dao at its source.
realm_39.title: Dao Source

realm_46.desc: Shatter the heavens and touch the realm of Open Heaven.
realm_46.title: Open Heaven

reincarnate_10.desc: Reincarnate 10 times. You remember every life.
reincarnate_10.title: Beyond the Wheel

reincarnate_2.desc: Reincarnate a second time. It got easier, did it not.
reincarnate_2.title: Second Wind

reincarnate_lowest.desc: Voluntarily reincarnate at the lowest available realm threshold.
reincarnate_lowest.title: Lin Family Trash

restless.desc: Switch screens 100 times in 5 minutes. Pick one, friend.
restless.title: Restless

settings_all.desc: Touch every setting at least once.

shop_100_visits.desc: Visit the shop 100 times. Always poor. Always smiling.

spark_drought.desc: Play for 1 hour without seeing a single spark. The wind is still.
spark_drought.title: Drought

sprite_tickle_100.desc: Tap the cultivator sprite 100 times. He felt that.
sprite_tickle_100.title: Tickle the Master

tap_1m.desc: Reach 1,000,000 lifetime crystal taps. Your phone is holding up.

tap_burst_100.desc: Tap 100 times in 10 seconds. We are worried.

time_midnight_tap.desc: Tap the crystal at exactly 00:00:00 local time.
time_midnight_tap.title: Witching Hour

time_night_owl.desc: Cross a realm boundary between 1am and 4am local time.
time_night_owl.title: Night Owl

beast.description: Unlock the Beast Pact Hidden Art across lives. (Coming soon.)

bloom.description: Begin each life with 50 Spirit Dew and the Verdant Tonic recipe already known.
bloom.label: Spirit Bloom

cauldron_5.label: Fifth Cauldron

echoes.description: Unlock the Treasure Hall Hidden Art across lives. (Coming soon.)

linger.description: Spirit Garden elixir buffs last 30% longer.

mastery.description: Strengthens the rewards of every Hidden Art. (Coming soon — effect being defined alongside the minigames.)
mastery.label: Hidden Art Mastery

n_1.label: Devoted Path

potency.description: Spirit Garden elixir buffs are 20% stronger.

resonance.description: Producers gain +1% increased Qi/s for each producer of the same type owned.

roster.description: The Roster (disciple promotion) stays unlocked every life, instead of relocking until your Disciples reach Mythic again.

rspark.description: Permanent Qi Spark buffs are 25% stronger.

star.label: Star Disciples

thousand.description: Your Disciple producer output is doubled.

foundation_radiance.desc: Permanently +4% qi/s for this life. Late-game.
foundation_radiance.name: Foundation Radiance Pill

foundation_root.desc: Permanently +3% karma gain for this life.

foundation_tide.desc: Permanently +5% offline qi catch-up for this life.

foundation_verdant.desc: Permanently +2% qi/s for this life (per heat tier, scales).

p_beast_pact.name: Beast Arena
p_beast_pact.tagline: Pit your pacted beasts up the spirit ladder.

p_disciple.name: The Roster
p_disciple.tagline: Promote your disciples up the cultivation ranks. The board sum lifts every disciple’s qi output.

p_dragon.name: Dragon Dream
p_dragon.tagline: Siphon as it breathes; bank before it wakes.

p_herb_garden.name: Spirit Garden
p_herb_garden.tagline: Sow spirit seeds, tend the plots, return to a heavy harvest.

p_meridian_furnace.name: Pill Refinement
p_meridian_furnace.tagline: Hold the flame true and fold rare reagents into a potent pill.

p_phoenix.name: Phoenix Pyre
p_phoenix.tagline: Ride the flame currents and gather feathers.

p_pillar.name: Pillar Ascent
p_pillar.tagline: Climb the heavenly pillar, dodge tribulation.

p_sect_followers.name: Sect Offerings
p_sect_followers.tagline: Marshal ten thousand disciples to the tithe.

p_treasure.name: Ancestral Echoes
p_treasure.tagline: Enshrine your ancestors for lasting blessings.

p_void.name: Void Channeling
p_void.tagline: Route the rift before it seals.

p_beast_pact.desc: You whistle once and they return from places no mortal could walk. Tigers with qi-storms tangled in their fur. Foxes with starlight on their tongues. They bring the harvest to your door.
p_beast_pact.name: Spirit Beast Pact

p_disciple.desc: An apprentice kneels in your courtyard, breath even, palms warm. The qi they draw from the air is one thin thread. Every thread strengthens the loom.
p_disciple.name: Body Tempering Disciple

p_dragon.desc: It dreams in your dantian, and one of its dreams is you. The pearl it coils around is older than mountains. Each slow exhalation gilds your meridians with cultivation you never had to earn.
p_dragon.name: Slumbering Spirit Dragon

p_herb_garden.desc: Jade leaves uncurl in the dawn and quietly drink the heavens dry. What the spirit herbs cannot use, they offer up to you.
p_herb_garden.name: Spirit Herb Garden

p_meridian_furnace.desc: Bronze legs, sealed lid, a fire that never gutters. Raw qi enters muddy and bitter; what reaches your meridians is denser than gold.
p_meridian_furnace.name: Meridian Furnace

p_phoenix.desc: The Fenghuang descends only when the cosmos itself agrees. It folds its rainbow wings around your soul. Every feather is a river. Every cry, a sutra older than heaven.
p_phoenix.name: Sovereign Phoenix

p_pillar.desc: Carved before your grandfather's grandfather, the pillar climbs until the clouds forget it began as stone. Through its length, the heavens themselves bleed down into your dantian.
p_pillar.name: Heavenly Pillar

p_sect_followers.desc: Ten thousand disciples wake at dawn and bow toward the hall that bears your sigil. A grain of rice from each becomes a mountain. A breath of qi from each becomes a river.
p_sect_followers.name: Mortal Sect Followers

p_treasure.desc: A jade pendant your ancestors carried for a hundred lifetimes. Every breath they took left a trace, and every trace bleeds back into you now, patient as a tide.
p_treasure.name: Ancestral Treasure

p_void.desc: A wound in reality, never closing, never bleeding less. Through it, qi from a world that is not yours pours into a world that is. Another universe is a generous tithe.
p_void.name: Void Conduit

consecutive_focus_t5.description: Adds: hold Focus 10s → +20% more qi/s (total +60%) and enter deep meditation.
consecutive_focus_t5.name: Consecutive Focus

crystal_click_t1.description: The crystal stockpiles 30% of your qi/s (up to 2 min). Tap to collect.
crystal_click_t1.name: Crystal Reservoir

crystal_click_t2.description: Upgrades to 50% of your qi/s (up to 3 min). Tap to collect.
crystal_click_t2.name: Crystal Reservoir

crystal_click_t3.description: Upgrades to 70% of your qi/s (up to 4 min). Tap to collect.
crystal_click_t3.name: Crystal Reservoir

crystal_click_t4.description: Upgrades to 85% of your qi/s (up to 5 min). Tap to collect.
crystal_click_t4.name: Crystal Reservoir

crystal_click_t5.description: Full rate: 100% of your qi/s (up to 6 min). Tap the crystal to collect.
crystal_click_t5.name: Crystal Reservoir

divine_qi_t1.description: A golden orb appears every ~10 min. Tap it within 8s for 25s of qi.
divine_qi_t1.name: Divine Qi

divine_qi_t2.description: Orb every ~9 min, 10s window. Tap for 35s of qi.
divine_qi_t2.name: Divine Qi

divine_qi_t3.description: Orb every ~8 min, 12s window. Tap for 50s of qi.
divine_qi_t3.name: Divine Qi

divine_qi_t4.description: Orb every ~7 min, 15s window. Tap for 65s of qi.
divine_qi_t4.name: Divine Qi

divine_qi_t5.description: Two orbs every ~6 min. Collect both for 75s qi + ×1.25 qi/s for 20s.
divine_qi_t5.name: Divine Qi

enduring_stream.description: +1% qi/s for the rest of this run. Stacks.
enduring_stream.name: Enduring Stream

heavens_bond.description: +3% offline qi accrual for the rest of this run. Stacks.
heavens_bond.name: Heaven's Bond

legendary_a1_smoke_petal.description: Each Spirit Herb Garden + Meridian Furnace pair multiplies both ×1.5. The garden's jade leaves curl in the furnace smoke and bloom faster; the furnace tastes the spirit-herb breath and burns hotter.
legendary_a1_smoke_petal.name: Smoke and Petal

legendary_a2_hall_ten_thousand.description: Each Body Tempering Disciple + Mortal Sect Follower pair multiplies both ×1.75. A single disciple becomes a focal point; ten thousand pilgrims bow toward them.
legendary_a2_hall_ten_thousand.name: Hall of Ten Thousand

legendary_a3_pearl_pendant.description: Each Slumbering Spirit Dragon + Ancestral Treasure pair multiplies both ×2. The dragon's slumber-pearl recognises a relic carried by your ancestors — they were always going to find each other again.
legendary_a3_pearl_pendant.name: The Pearl and the Pendant

legendary_a4_climbing_beasts.description: Each Spirit Beast Pact + Heavenly Pillar pair adds +10% global qi/s. The tigers climb the pillar at midnight to drink directly. They don't tell the foxes. The foxes find out.
legendary_a4_climbing_beasts.name: Climbing Beasts

legendary_a5_void_garden.description: Each Void Conduit + Spirit Herb Garden pair multiplies both ×2.5. The void's bleed carries seeds from another world; the garden devours them, blooms in colors no eye has named.
legendary_a5_void_garden.name: Void Garden

legendary_a6_phoenix_pillar.description: Each Sovereign Phoenix + Heavenly Pillar pair multiplies both ×3. The Fenghuang lands only on a perch tall enough. Each pillar is one step closer to heaven.
legendary_a6_phoenix_pillar.name: Phoenix and Pillar

legendary_b1_dragon_hoard.description: Slumbering Spirit Dragon +25% qi/s per Ancestral Treasure owned. The dragon's pearl is whatever you offered it. Every relic you've kept, it has folded into itself.
legendary_b1_dragon_hoard.name: Dragon's Hoard

legendary_b3_beast_tribute.description: Spirit Beast Pact +12% qi/s per Spirit Herb Garden owned. Tigers eat the spirit herbs you grow. They return larger, faster, sharper.
legendary_b3_beast_tribute.name: Beast Tribute

legendary_b4_furnace_sect.description: Meridian Furnace +4% qi/s per Body Tempering Disciple. Every apprentice's breath stokes the bronze legs a little brighter. The furnace was always a sect's effort.
legendary_b4_furnace_sect.name: Furnace of the Sect

legendary_b5_heavens_bend.description: Heavenly Pillar ×2 qi/s if you own at least 1 Void Conduit. When reality is already torn, heaven stops resisting.
legendary_b5_heavens_bend.name: Heavens Bend Down

legendary_b6_phoenix_garden.description: Sovereign Phoenix +5% qi/s per Spirit Herb Garden owned. Fenghuang nests only where the soil is medicine. A hundred gardens, a hundred reasons to stay.
legendary_b6_phoenix_garden.name: Phoenix's Garden

legendary_e2_phoenix_reborn.description: Every realm breakthrough resets your Phoenix count to 0 but permanently adds +50% to every other producer's qi/s for this run. Fenghuang is reborn from its own ashes — to bless the sect of its hearth.
legendary_e2_phoenix_reborn.name: Phoenix Reborn

legendary_f1_storm_tiger.description: Spirit Beast Pact ×2 qi/s. The tiger paces, ears flat. It will not roar until a dragon dreams its name and a phoenix sings it back. Until then, the storm in its fur only mutters.
legendary_f1_storm_tiger.name: Storm-Furred Tiger

legendary_f2_pearl_dragon.description: Slumbering Spirit Dragon ×2 qi/s. The pearl warms when the dragon hears two distant sounds — a tiger pacing, a phoenix folding its rainbow wings. Only then does the dream finish.
legendary_f2_pearl_dragon.name: Pearl-Dream Dragon

legendary_f3_rainbow_phoenix.description: Sovereign Phoenix ×2 qi/s. The Fenghuang's cry has three notes. Alone it sings one — somewhere a tiger paces, somewhere a dragon dreams. When all three sound, the heavens bend down.
legendary_f3_rainbow_phoenix.name: Rainbow-Cry Phoenix

masters_patience.description: Each second held in Focus this run gives +0.1% qi/s. Stacks. Per-stack cap +12%.
masters_patience.name: Master's Patience

pattern_click_t1.description: A pattern spark appears every ~12 min. Tap to begin: 3 dots, 10s to clear for 30s of qi.
pattern_click_t1.name: Tracing Meridians

pattern_click_t2.description: Spark every ~11 min. 4 dots, 12s window. Full clear: 40s of qi.
pattern_click_t2.name: Tracing Meridians

pattern_click_t3.description: Spark every ~10 min. 5 dots, 14s window. Full clear: 55s of qi.
pattern_click_t3.name: Tracing Meridians

pattern_click_t4.description: Spark every ~9 min. 6 dots, 16s window. Full clear: 70s of qi.
pattern_click_t4.name: Tracing Meridians

pattern_click_t5.description: Spark every ~8 min. 7 dots, 18s window. Full clear: 90s qi + ×1.5 qi/s for 20s.
pattern_click_t5.name: Tracing Meridians

quick_burst.description: Instant qi gain worth 30 seconds of your current qi/s.
quick_burst.name: Quick Burst

resonant_soul.description: +0.2% qi/s for every layer breakthrough you reach this run. Stacks.
resonant_soul.name: Resonant Soul

sect_discipline.description: For 90 seconds, every producer gains +1 per-unit qi/s. Disciples breathe in time.
sect_discipline.name: Sect Discipline

sharper_focus.description: +2% Focus multiplier for the rest of this run. Stacks.
sharper_focus.name: Sharper Focus

steady_cultivation.description: +0.3 base qi/s for the rest of this run. Stacks.
steady_cultivation.name: Steady Cultivation

tinkers_bargain.description: Your next 5 producer purchases cost -30% qi. The bargain favours the early bird.
tinkers_bargain.name: Tinker's Bargain

buff_crimson_aura_12h.desc: ×2 qi/s for 12 hours. The "going to sleep" pack.
buff_crimson_aura_12h.name: Crimson Aura — 12h

buff_crimson_aura_1h.desc: ×2 qi/s for 1 hour. Cultivator wears a crimson halo while active.
buff_crimson_aura_1h.name: Crimson Aura — 1h

buff_crimson_aura_4h.desc: ×2 qi/s for 4 hours. Best value per minute for active grinders.
buff_crimson_aura_4h.name: Crimson Aura — 4h

buff_crystal_resonance_30m.desc: ×2 qi granted per crystal tap, 30 min. Stack with Refined Tap upgrades for huge taps.
buff_crystal_resonance_30m.name: Crystal Resonance — 30m

buff_producer_surge_4h.desc: ×1.5 to every producer's base rate for 4 hours. Stacks multiplicatively with upgrades.
buff_producer_surge_4h.name: Producer Surge — 4h

consumable_major_bt_bypass.desc: Skip the qi/s gate on your next major breakthrough. You still pay the qi cost — but no need to push your rate first.
consumable_major_bt_bypass.name: Heaven's Pardon

cos_char_bone_patriarch.desc: A withered elder of the ossuary sect. Evolves through all 13 realms with you.
cos_char_bone_patriarch.name: Bone Patriarch

cos_char_frost_ascetic.desc: A wind-bitten monk of the frozen peaks. Evolves through all 13 realms with you.
cos_char_frost_ascetic.name: Frost Ascetic

cos_char_lotus_sage.desc: Petals bloom around an ascetic's frame. Evolves through all 13 realms.
cos_char_lotus_sage.name: Lotus Sage

cos_char_storm_caller.desc: Cloud-silk robes, eyes lit with lightning. Evolves through all 13 realms.
cos_char_storm_caller.name: Storm Caller

cos_crystal_frost.desc: A glacial shard carved by winter cultivators. Evolves through all 10 tiers.
cos_crystal_frost.name: Frost Crystal

cos_crystal_ossuary.desc: A crystal lattice grown through ancient bone. Evolves through all 10 tiers.
cos_crystal_ossuary.name: Ossuary Crystal

cos_crystal_phoenix.desc: A molten ember bound in crystal lattice. Evolves through all 10 tiers.
cos_crystal_phoenix.name: Phoenix Core

cos_particles_c9_10.desc: Intricate qi nodes with an ordered inner pattern.
cos_particles_c9_10.name: Arcane Orb

cos_particles_c9_11.desc: Coiled qi. Carries the concentrated force of a dragon.
cos_particles_c9_11.name: Dragon Mote

cos_particles_c9_12.desc: Warm rising orbs. Bright inner core like flame reforming.
cos_particles_c9_12.name: Phoenix Orb

cos_particles_c9_13.desc: Crackles with contained charge. Never quite still.
cos_particles_c9_13.name: Storm Mote

cos_particles_c9_14.desc: Carries the memory of a hundred thunderclaps.
cos_particles_c9_14.name: Thunder Orb

cos_particles_c9_15.desc: The pinnacle form. Dense, bright, perfectly balanced qi.
cos_particles_c9_15.name: Supreme Mote

cos_particles_c9_2.desc: Trailing wisps of raw qi. Leave a faint luminous tail.
cos_particles_c9_2.name: Wisp Mote

cos_particles_c9_3.desc: Compact star-form orbs that flicker with celestial light.
cos_particles_c9_3.name: Star Mote

cos_particles_c9_4.desc: Compressed qi, heavy with intent. Tight inner glow.
cos_particles_c9_4.name: Dense Core

cos_particles_c9_5.desc: Soft and diffuse. Dissolves into you like morning fog.
cos_particles_c9_5.name: Mist Orb

cos_particles_c9_6.desc: An older form of qi manifestation. Raw and resonant.
cos_particles_c9_6.name: Primal Orb

cos_particles_c9_7.desc: Qi shaped around a crystalline lattice. Hard-edged inner glow.
cos_particles_c9_7.name: Crystal Mote

cos_particles_c9_8.desc: Barely material qi. More radiance than substance.
cos_particles_c9_8.name: Ethereal Orb

cos_particles_c9_9.desc: Heaven-grade orbs. Carry a distant, ancient echo.
cos_particles_c9_9.name: Celestial Mote

qol_autobuy_cheapest.desc: Unlocks an Auto-Buy toggle on the Sect screen. While enabled, qi auto-spends on the cheapest available producer.
qol_autobuy_cheapest.name: Disciple's Diligence

qol_offline_cap_2h.desc: Extends the offline qi-accrual cap by 2 hours. Stack-able up to 3 times (max +6h on top of the base 8h cap).
qol_offline_cap_2h.name: Patient Mind +2h

qol_skip_bt_confirm.desc: Auto-confirms major breakthroughs the moment the gate clears. Skips the celebratory pause.
qol_skip_bt_confirm.name: Decisive Heart

enduring_stream.exampleText: Five stacks compound to roughly +5% total qi/s. Small but reliable, never expires.
enduring_stream.loreText: The river that never stops becomes the sea.

heavens_bond.effectText: **+3% offline qi rate** this run. Stacks.
heavens_bond.exampleText: Base offline rate is 20%. Three stacks lift it to 29% offline rate, so your sect cultivates a little harder while you sleep.
heavens_bond.loreText: The heavens do not require your attention. Only your alignment.

legendary_a1_smoke_petal.effectText: Each **Herb Garden + Meridian Furnace** pair: both produce **×1.5**.
legendary_a1_smoke_petal.exampleText: Own 3 gardens + 5 furnaces, so 3 pairs, each garden's AND each furnace's qi/s is multiplied by ×2.5 (1 + 3 × 0.5).
legendary_a1_smoke_petal.loreText: The garden's jade leaves curl in the furnace smoke and bloom faster; the furnace tastes the spirit-herb breath and burns hotter.

legendary_a2_hall_ten_thousand.effectText: Each **Tempering Disciple + Sect Follower** pair: both produce **×1.75**.
legendary_a2_hall_ten_thousand.exampleText: Own 10 disciples + 4 sect followers, so 4 pairs, each producer's qi/s is multiplied by ×4 (1 + 4 × 0.75).
legendary_a2_hall_ten_thousand.loreText: A single disciple becomes a focal point; ten thousand pilgrims bow toward them. The pilgrim sees the disciple; the disciple feels the weight.

legendary_a3_pearl_pendant.effectText: Each **Spirit Dragon + Ancestral Treasure** pair: both produce **×2**.
legendary_a3_pearl_pendant.exampleText: Own 2 dragons + 5 treasures, so 2 pairs, each producer's qi/s is multiplied by ×3 (1 + 2 × 1).
legendary_a3_pearl_pendant.loreText: The dragon's slumber-pearl recognises a relic carried by your ancestors. They were never separated. They were always going to find each other again.

legendary_a4_climbing_beasts.effectText: Each **Spirit Beast + Heavenly Pillar** pair: **+10% global qi/s**.
legendary_a4_climbing_beasts.exampleText: Own 5 beast pacts + 8 pillars, so 5 pairs, gives +50% global qi/s on ALL your production.
legendary_a4_climbing_beasts.loreText: The tigers climb the heavenly pillar at midnight to drink directly. They don't tell the foxes. The foxes find out.

legendary_a5_void_garden.effectText: Each **Void Conduit + Herb Garden** pair: both produce **×2.5**.
legendary_a5_void_garden.exampleText: Own 3 void conduits + 10 gardens, so 3 pairs, each producer's qi/s is multiplied by ×5.5 (1 + 3 × 1.5).
legendary_a5_void_garden.loreText: The void's bleed carries seeds from another world; the garden devours them, blooms in colors no eye has named.

legendary_a6_phoenix_pillar.effectText: Each **Sovereign Phoenix + Heavenly Pillar** pair: both produce **×3**.
legendary_a6_phoenix_pillar.exampleText: Own 1 phoenix + 10 pillars, so 1 pair, both producers' qi/s is multiplied by ×3. Adding a 2nd phoenix gives 2 pairs and ×5 each.
legendary_a6_phoenix_pillar.loreText: The Fenghuang lands only on a perch tall enough. Each pillar is one more step closer to heaven.

legendary_b1_dragon_hoard.effectText: **Spirit Dragon** gains **+25% qi/s** per Ancestral Treasure owned.
legendary_b1_dragon_hoard.exampleText: Own 1 dragon + 10 treasures, dragon's qi/s is ×3.5 (1 + 10 × 0.25). At 20 treasures, ×6.
legendary_b1_dragon_hoard.loreText: The dragon's pearl is whatever you offered it. Every relic you've kept, it has folded into itself.

legendary_b3_beast_tribute.effectText: **Spirit Beast Pact** gains **+12% qi/s** per Spirit Herb Garden.
legendary_b3_beast_tribute.exampleText: Own 10 beast pacts + 15 gardens, each beast pact's qi/s is ×2.8 (1 + 15 × 0.12).
legendary_b3_beast_tribute.loreText: Tigers eat the spirit herbs you grow. They return larger, faster, sharper.

legendary_b4_furnace_sect.effectText: **Meridian Furnace** gains **+4% qi/s** per Tempering Disciple.
legendary_b4_furnace_sect.exampleText: Own 5 furnaces + 50 disciples, each furnace's qi/s is ×3 (1 + 50 × 0.04).
legendary_b4_furnace_sect.loreText: Every apprentice's breath stokes the bronze legs a little brighter. The furnace was always a sect's effort.

legendary_b5_heavens_bend.effectText: **Heavenly Pillar** produces **double qi/s** while you own ≥1 Void Conduit.
legendary_b5_heavens_bend.exampleText: Own 10 pillars + 1 void, each pillar's qi/s is ×2. Owning more voids doesn't increase the bonus further.
legendary_b5_heavens_bend.loreText: When reality is already torn, heaven stops resisting.

legendary_b6_phoenix_garden.effectText: **Sovereign Phoenix** gains **+5% qi/s** per Spirit Herb Garden.
legendary_b6_phoenix_garden.exampleText: Own 1 phoenix + 40 gardens, phoenix's qi/s is ×3 (1 + 40 × 0.05).
legendary_b6_phoenix_garden.loreText: Fenghuang nests only where the soil is medicine. A hundred gardens, a hundred reasons to stay.

legendary_e2_phoenix_reborn.effectText: Each major realm: **Phoenix → 0**, all other producers **+50% qi/s** permanently.
legendary_e2_phoenix_reborn.exampleText: Cross 5 major realms with this active and every non-phoenix producer ends at ×3.5 their normal output (1 + 5 × 0.5). You lose all phoenixes, but the rest of your sect grows steadily.
legendary_e2_phoenix_reborn.loreText: Fenghuang is reborn from its own ashes, to bless the sect of its hearth.

legendary_f1_storm_tiger.effectText: **Spirit Beast Pact: double qi/s**. Trinity Beast: collect all 3 for **+100% global**.
legendary_f1_storm_tiger.exampleText: Own 10 beast pacts, combined qi/s is doubled. With the Dragon and Phoenix sparks also active, Trinity Convergence adds +100% global qi/s on top of every producer.
legendary_f1_storm_tiger.loreText: The tiger paces, ears flat. It will not roar until a dragon dreams its name and a phoenix sings it back. Until then, the storm in its fur only mutters.

legendary_f2_pearl_dragon.effectText: **Spirit Dragon: double qi/s**. Trinity Beast: collect all 3 for **+100% global**.
legendary_f2_pearl_dragon.exampleText: Own 1 dragon, its qi/s is doubled. With the Tiger and Phoenix sparks also active, Trinity Convergence adds +100% global qi/s on top of every producer.
legendary_f2_pearl_dragon.loreText: The pearl warms when the dragon hears two distant sounds, a tiger pacing, a phoenix folding its rainbow wings. Only then does the dream finish.

legendary_f3_rainbow_phoenix.effectText: **Sovereign Phoenix: double qi/s**. Trinity Beast: collect all 3 for **+100% global**.
legendary_f3_rainbow_phoenix.exampleText: Own 1 phoenix, its qi/s is doubled. With the Tiger and Dragon sparks also active, Trinity Convergence adds +100% global qi/s on top of every producer.
legendary_f3_rainbow_phoenix.loreText: The Fenghuang's cry has three notes. Alone it sings one. Somewhere a tiger paces, somewhere a dragon dreams. When all three sound, the heavens bend down.

masters_patience.effectText: **+0.1% qi/s** per second of Focus held. Caps at **+12%** per stack.
masters_patience.exampleText: Hold Focus a total of 2 minutes (120s) over the run and 1 stack gives +12% qi/s at the cap. Three stacks reach +36% qi/s until you reincarnate.
masters_patience.loreText: The longest breath is the slowest. A master can rest inside a single inhale for an hour.

quick_burst.effectText: Instant qi worth **30 seconds** of your current qi/s.
quick_burst.exampleText: If your qi/s is currently 1.2M, picking this spark adds 36M qi to your balance.
quick_burst.loreText: A breath drawn quick, and the world tilts toward you.

resonant_soul.effectText: **+0.2% qi/s** per breakthrough reached after drawing. Stacks.
resonant_soul.exampleText: After 50 breakthroughs with this active, one stack gives +10% qi/s. Draw early for the biggest payoff.
resonant_soul.loreText: Every breakthrough leaves a tone. The soul gathers them like bells in a temple.

sect_discipline.effectText: **+1 base qi/s** to every producer unit for 90 seconds.
sect_discipline.exampleText: Own 20 disciples (base 0.1 qi/s each) and each disciple temporarily produces 1.1 qi/s (×11) for 90s. Late game with 100+ mythic producers, the +1 is small per unit but applies to every unit you own.
sect_discipline.loreText: Ten thousand disciples bow at once. The hall remembers what one breath, multiplied, can do.

sharper_focus.exampleText: Three stacks make your Focus +6% stronger. Especially useful if you Focus often.
sharper_focus.loreText: The blade is sharpened on the same stone, every morning.

steady_cultivation.exampleText: Drawn three times gives +0.9 base qi/s. The flat bonus is multiplied by crystal, Focus, and other multipliers, so it matters most in the early game.
steady_cultivation.loreText: One breath at dawn, one at dusk. The thousandth breath is the same as the first, and that is the whole secret.

steady_stream.effectText: **+20% qi/s** for the next full minute.
steady_stream.exampleText: A steady +20% for 60 seconds gives you roughly 12 seconds of bonus production.
steady_stream.loreText: Slow flame. Long burn. The mountain wears down the rain.

surging_stream.exampleText: At 1M qi/s baseline, this temporarily raises you to 1.5M qi/s for half a minute.
surging_stream.loreText: The current rises. The river forgets its banks.

tinkers_bargain.effectText: **-30% qi** on your next **5 producer purchases**.
tinkers_bargain.exampleText: Buying a tier-4 producer that normally costs 1.2M qi costs 840k qi with the discount applied. Each buy click (×1 or ×10) spends one charge. Charges persist across reloads until spent.
tinkers_bargain.loreText: The tinker counts coins by lamplight. "Five favours," he says. "Spend them where the price hurts most."

first_layer_bt.body: Your meridians widen. Each layer you cross brings new producers, sparks, and upgrades within reach. Keep cultivating; the next layer is already in sight.
first_layer_bt.title: First Breakthrough

first_major_gate.body: A major realm asks for two things at once. You need qi in the bank, and a sustained qi/s rate to push through the gate. Build more producers, level your crystal, hold Focus. Tap BREAKTHROUGH when the heavens stop pushing back.
first_major_gate.title: The Heavens Test You

first_producer.body: A disciple kneels in your courtyard. Every disciple you train lifts your idle qi/s a little, and the next one costs slightly more than the last. The same shape holds for every producer you'll unlock.
first_producer.title: The Disciple Bows

first_saint.body: You can reincarnate from here on. The progress of this life turns into karma, and karma buys permanent boosts on the Eternal Tree. Every life makes the next one start a little stronger. Keep grinding this run if it's still moving, or rebirth whenever the climb starts to drag.
first_saint.title: A Second Life

first_spark_offer.body: Every layer breakthrough offers a Spark. Two cards appear and you pick one. Some give a short boost, some stack permanently for this run, and the rare ones unlock new mechanics. If neither card tempts you, your first reroll on every offer is free.
first_spark_offer.title: Qi Sparks

hold_to_focus.body: Press and hold the cultivator. Your qi/s climbs sharply while you hold, and drops back when you release. The early layers go by much faster with your thumb on the screen.
hold_to_focus.title: Hold to Focus

producers_hint.body: Your breath alone fills the meridians slowly. Other hands can draw the heavens down with you. Visit the Sect hall to gather disciples, raise gardens, and shape the sources that gather qi while you sit still.
producers_hint.title: You do not climb alone

producers_tab.body: Producers gather qi for you in the background, even when you're not tapping. Each one raises your qi/s permanently for the rest of this life. Their price creeps up after every purchase, but each new tier outclasses the last. Spend your qi the moment you can afford one.
producers_tab.title: Producers

welcome.body: Qi flows in with every breath. Fill the bar at the bottom of the screen to break through a layer of your realm. Layers stack into realms, realms stack into the heavens. The path is long.
welcome.title: The Path Begins
